heading_en: Credit Equivalent Amounts of Off-Balance Sheet Transactions
summary_ja: オフ・バランス取引の与信相当額を想定元本額に取引種類ごとの掛目（十〜百パーセント）を乗じて算出し、資産売却等の対象資産に係る与信相当額と、一定の要件を満たす取消可能コミットメントの算出不要を定める。
summary_en: Credit equivalent amounts of off-balance sheet items = notional × credit conversion factor (10% to 100% by type, per the tables); asset sales with recourse and forward purchases at 100% of the underlying; qualifying unconditionally cancellable commitments to businesses are exempt.
paragraphs: Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach engages in an off-balance sheet transaction listed in the middle column of the following table, the credit equivalent amount relating to the credit risk to the counterparty of that off-balance sheet transaction shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the notional principal amount of that off-balance sheet transaction (which must be an amount reflecting the economic effect of the transaction, not the apparent amount; the same applies hereinafter) by the conversion factor listed in the upper column of the following table. {{T:p92t0}} (Note 1) Where a commitment to carry out an off-balance sheet transaction in the future has been made and multiple conversion factors could apply, the lowest of those conversion factors shall be applied. (Note 2) Where, in a repo-style transaction between a client and a third party, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach guarantees to the client the performance of the third party's obligations, the transaction shall be deemed to have been carried out by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach and shall be treated in accordance with item (vii) or item (viii).

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach engages in an off-balance sheet transaction listed in the middle column of the following table, the credit equivalent amount relating to the assets subject to the transaction shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the notional principal amount of the transaction by the conversion factor listed in the upper column of the following table. In this case, the risk weight applied to that credit equivalent amount shall be the risk weight of the assets traded. {{T:p94t1}} (Note) For the sales of assets with recourse provided in item (i), where the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach bears part of the loss from the original obligor's default or a decline in the value of the assets, and the maximum amount it would bear is less than the amount equivalent to 8% of the amount obtained by multiplying the credit equivalent amount of the assets sold by the risk weight (referred to as the "converted amount" in this Note), the amount obtained by deducting from the converted amount the amount obtained by dividing that shortfall by 8% shall be the credit risk-weighted assets relating to that transaction.

Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph (1), for off-balance sheet transactions that satisfy all of the following requirements (limited to those listed in item (i) of the table of that paragraph), it is not necessary to calculate the credit equivalent amount. (i) That the counterparty is a corporate, etc.; provided, however, that where an individual who is a business operator is the counterparty, this is limited to where the off-balance sheet transaction is for business purposes. (ii) That no fees or similar expenses are received in concluding and maintaining the transaction contract. (iii) That each time the counterparty draws on the credit facility, an application is made by the counterparty. (iv) That the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach has full authority over drawings on the credit facility by the counterparty. (v) That, in approving drawings on the credit facility by the counterparty, the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach assesses the counterparty's creditworthiness each time an application provided in item (iii) is made.
